description: PLACEHOLDER for the real whole-house golden fixture (the preferred accuracy gate: reconciles the WHOLE bill month's half-hourly meter consumption, so only two figures are needed from the bill: billed kWh and billed energy cost EXCLUDING the standing charge). While status is 'placeholder' the golden test SKIPS this file with an explicit reason — never a silent pass. Generate on the LAN with: scripts/export-golden-fixture.py --mode whole-house --month YYYY-MM --billed-kwh <kWh> --billed-cost-inc-vat <GBP, energy only, NO standing charge> (Octopus creds from backend/.env). The file it writes is git-ignored and kept locally: the golden test picks it up on the machine that holds it. CAVEAT: Octopus exposes only recent smart-charge dispatches; for older months daytime dispatch slots price at peak, so the computed cost may exceed the bill (positive delta).
